botManager.name: Bot manager
botManager.detail: Critical. One person builds the bot for you, with no power over chat or your channel.
botManager.can: They can create and edit commands, timers, pipelines, event responses, triggers, widgets, sounds, quotes, and voice and music setup.
botManager.cannot: They cannot moderate chat, change channel settings, control OBS, or manage roles.
